## About
Rowlett Service Center is a family owned and operated auto repair shop in Rowlett, serving drivers here and across the greater DFW area. One customer mentions Ron Wallace as the owner.
We treat our customers like family and work on every car as if it belonged to one of our own. You get the quality parts, equipment and services of a big-chain auto center, with the attention of a local shop.
From oil changes and tires to transmissions, engines and electrical work, we are here to take care of you and your car, and to do what's right to keep your family safe on the road.

## Services
- Oil changes and maintenance: Oil changes, filters, fluid services, tune ups and factory scheduled maintenance.
- Brake repair: Brake repair along with brake and lamp inspections.
- Tire services: Tire rotation, mounting, balancing and wheel alignment.
- Transmission service and repair: Transmission service, new and rebuilt transmissions, driveline, axle and differential work.
- Check engine light diagnostics: Computer diagnostics to find out why that light came on.
- Air conditioning service and repair: Service and repair to keep your air conditioning working.
- Safety and emissions inspections: Safety and emissions inspections for your vehicle.
- Suspension and steering repair: Suspension, steering, shocks and struts.
- Electrical system diagnosis and repair: Tracking down and fixing electrical problems.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Saturdays?
A: Yes. We're open Saturday from 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM.

Q: Do you work on work trucks and company vehicles?
A: Yes. Fleet services are part of what we do, and one customer says we've worked on their commercial and personal vehicles for years.

Q: How do I use one of your specials?
A: Bring the coupon with you when you pay. You can print it or just show it on your phone.
